notes.title: We Are Exiting Early Access!
notes.content:
After almost 3 months in early access, we are ready to officially launch Cribbish. A ton of content and features have been added in the past 90 days, not the least of which is:

[list]
[*] Infinite replayability — Every hand is a puzzle. Every run, a new strategy.
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Speed Running
[*] 20+ different challenging decks to choose from
[*] 4 different difficulties to choose from
[*] 14 different card enhancements to power up the cards in your deck
[*] 100+ relics, each with it's own unique ability to boost your game
[*] 25+ potions to provide you with instant help when needed
[*] 35+ perks that you can use to bend the rules in your favor or upgrade your relics/potions
[*] 50+ brutal and elite challenges to stand in your way as you climb the peg board
[*] Over a dozen hidden easter eggs to discover
[/list]

tags.feature: - Endless Mode
- Speed Running
- 20+ different challenging decks to choose from
- 4 different difficulties to choose from
- 14 different card enhancements to power up the cards in your deck
- 100+ relics, each with it's own unique ability to boost your game
- 25+ potions to provide you with instant help when needed
- 35+ perks that you can use to bend the rules in your favor or upgrade your relics/potions
- 50+ brutal and elite challenges to stand in your way as you climb the peg board
- Over a dozen hidden easter eggs to discover

notes.title: Build 0.9.65 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
A lot of new stuff here in this one.

[list]
[*] Handful of Easter eggs sprinkled about, some are just for fun and some spice up the game itself a little...
[*] The Glacial Ember relic has been added
[*] Kings Tithe is now taken up front before checking to see if level has been won
[*] Kings Tithe is no longer restored with KK is scored, instead a pair of KK prevents the tithe
[*] Made Lock and Key easier to match and scalable with the game
[*] The Book of Luck perk upgrade is meaningful now
[*] Clicking on sort by suit multiple times in a row will rotate the order of the suits in the sort
[*] Stats and Discoveries are now honored when playing a Challenge Deck
[*] Fixed Perilux card bug so nows there's a true 3% chance of it breaking
[*] The Lucky Perk has been added. Increase your luck and things will start going your way
[*] Perks that have a limited # uses now tell you that in their tooltip
[*] All base line potion and relic sell prices are the greater of $1 or half of purchase price
[*] Removed crib card count limit of 18 cards
[*] Added ability to abort counting and end the hand
[*] Added user stat tracking for speed running (best time per deck, per difficulty)
[*] Fixed an issue with the Tetraquark upgrade perks tooltip
[*] Steepened the Endless Mode scoring ramp
[*] Fixed unlock requirement tooltip for the Glacial Ember relic
[*] Added picture icons for the set perks instead of showing the cards of the hand
[/list]

tags.bug: The Poker Mania deck no longer gives you the impossible challenge of getting 4 Fifteens

tags.feature: Added some color coding to MAIN HAND and THE CRIB wording in relic tooltips for faster comprehension

tags.bug: Lyrebird now works correctly when the crib is being counted
Eye of Ghormech now functions correctly, even in the Revolution deck

tags.feature: Put in some temporary artwork for face cards to see how people like having real face cards again

notes.title: 0.9.32 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Lyrebird is now limited to cloning at most 3 cards
[*] Fixed relics creeping up the screen when counting at max speed
[*] Fixed Cardsmith button not enabling when a relic is sold for coins
[*] Fixed Cardsmith "Remove Card" perk from carry over to next run
[*] Fixed view deck page to look nicer when you have more than 30 cards in one suit
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.31 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Maternal Crib now gives +2 mult PER queen and activates before counting starts
[*] Emerald cards now give their multiplier at the beginning of the hand
[*] Crib cards now give their multiplier at the beginning of crib counting
[*] Fixed re-triggering of gold cards when Gold Mine relic is in play
[*] Fixed level 8.3 occasionally not being assigned a Brute Challenge, making level impossible to pass
[*] Consolation Prize tooltip updated to reflect that the Draw counter will not be decremented
[*] Fixed Veil of Seraphis issue where the prices in the shop always show $0, even after the free one
[*] Fixed issue with Meteor Storm giving out massive multipliers
[*] Cleaned up Prodigal Son tooltip so it's easier to understand how it works
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.30 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Added tooltips for the 2 sorting buttons
Fixed phrasings in several of the relics
Undiscovered items no longer show their Name when in the Store
When Steam Achievement API calls fail, we now cache and retry on next app launch
Game handles player running out of cards in a more graceful manner now
